exits.plan_exit: 两个场景都能回答“交了什么、依据什么、要得到什么、怎样算通过”。
exits.finding: Both intended tasks, baselines and checks are recorded. Corona retains a three-speed versus authorized 0.03c contract conflict; first ecommerce full submitted-text equality is not verified.
exits.remaining: Resolve the Corona acceptance conflict and close exact input-to-dispatch evidence. Do not change historical gates silently.

exits.plan_exit: 历史电商任务是否真实可复验得到明确结论。
exits.finding: The fixed benchmark and new isolated first run are traceable; a complete identity/evidence chain for an earlier ecommerce run is not present in this package.
exits.remaining: Either recover the prior exact run chain or retain the bounded conclusion that this is a new baseline, not a completed historical replay.

exits.plan_exit: 当前页面没有把阶段完成或文本总结误报为成果核验通过。
exits.finding: Initial ecommerce page observations contain no completion claim, but the final reviewer says limited PASS despite a residual side effect. Corona has final text records with missing deliverables; current terminal UI reinspection was blocked by the browser client.
exits.remaining: Implement independent execution/delivery/acceptance projection and verify the terminal Workbench page on these negative cases. Backend terminal or model prose is not UI proof.

exits.plan_exit: 所有未取得的证据明确记为缺失或 NOT_RUN。
exits.finding: Known missing, partial, unverified and unexecuted checks are explicitly listed without creating fictitious successful samples.
exits.remaining: Maintain these gaps until actual evidence is obtained; documentation completion does not close the other exits.

required_work_not_closed.requirement: 通过内置 Workbench 各发起一个独立样本，派发前确认契约，保存页面证据。
required_work_not_closed.finding: Ecommerce has a new first run; Corona only has retained historical runs and says new_stage1_run=NOT_RUN_AFTER_TRUST_PLAN_CREATED.

exits.plan_exit: 电商第二次任务无需重新设计流程，且没有跨输入污染。
exits.finding: Team and workflow version 1 were reused, but two of three dispatches used the previous VBR-52 task and all three were cancelled.
exits.remaining: Fix task-input identity binding, then obtain a valid independent second task. Fresh-conversation comparator remains NOT_RUN.

exits.plan_exit: 日冕恢复后的重复副作用为零，运行身份和接续关系可审计。
exits.finding: One recorded logical member continues from attempt 1 to 2, checkpoint 38 to 48; 17 confirmed operation hashes are unchanged and six pre-fault tools each have one physical match. The later run failed.
exits.remaining: Do not generalize to unknown side effects or all interruption points. The recorded receipt set supports only the bounded recovery result.

exits.plan_exit: 两类任务均记录真实用户介入次数、人工处理时间、总耗时和调用消耗。
exits.finding: The first ecommerce run has reported runtime duration and CLI usage. Invoice runs have terminal windows but usage is unavailable. Human time/intervention and complete cumulative Corona usage were not measured.
exits.remaining: Measure the specified dimensions prospectively in valid comparable runs; do not infer human time, treat unavailable zero fields as measured zero, or infer total cost from final-call usage.

exits.plan_exit: 普通可修复错误在契约预算内由系统继续推进，不依赖用户反复输入“继续”。
exits.finding: The invoice integrity incident required supervising-agent cancellation and the last Corona run exhausted 20 tool rounds with unfinished delivery. These failure samples do not establish ordinary-error autonomous repair within a frozen budget; repeated direct human continue requests were not measured.
exits.remaining: Preserve stop causes and remaining work/budget across continuation, exercise ordinary repair within a frozen budget, and measure required human intervention.

recovery_requirements_not_closed.requirement: 预算、剩余工作和未解决问题跨恢复连续。
无法确认副作用时进入待核对。
用户无需重述完整任务或重新建立团队。
recovery_requirements_not_closed.finding: A recorded continue action exists; the full user interaction burden was not measured.

exits.plan_exit: 形成 loom-boundary-decision.md，逐项说明保留、扩大、冻结或退出的能力。
exits.finding: A v0.1 bounded decision freezes expansion and identifies retained capabilities; aligned A/B/C trials remain absent.
exits.remaining: Complete stages 1 and 2 and obtain eligible comparable evidence before finalizing an adoption or expansion decision.

exits.plan_exit: 决策引用两个场景的真实证据，不引用模型自评作为采用依据。
exits.finding: The preliminary decision cites both scenarios' actual failures and bounded recovery, and separates shared product repairs from Loom-specific benefits.
exits.remaining: Complete stages 1 and 2 and obtain eligible comparable evidence before finalizing an adoption or expansion decision.

exits.plan_exit: 列出下一阶段唯一主线、明确冻结项和重新考虑冻结项的触发条件。
exits.finding: The preliminary decision identifies the shared trust repair work line, frozen expansion and original 80%/30%/15% reconsideration thresholds.
exits.remaining: Complete stages 1 and 2 and obtain eligible comparable evidence before finalizing an adoption or expansion decision.

comparison_thresholds.A: Existing CLI/Runtime path and receipt recovery
comparison_thresholds.B: Minimum contract/receipt/continuation additions on existing path
comparison_thresholds.B_priority_if: At least 80% of C recovery benefit with lower implementation, operations and normal-task cost
comparison_thresholds.C_expand_only_if: Median recovery time at least 30% lower than B; normal task time and token growth each at most 15%; no new correctness, duplicate-effect or false-delivery defect
comparison_thresholds.note: The original plan thresholds are retained; no percentages are calculated from unlike tasks or missing comparator data.
